descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S26 「病程时间线只保留今天和昨天：日期为 D-3、D-2、D-1 和 D0 的行」 Course timeline keeps today and yesterday only: lines dated D-3, D-2, D-1 and D0

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U16 The Hospital course timeline keeps only today's and yesterday's lines (server days); older lines are deleted from the chart, not only hidden.（UAT 3.6 (course timeline and prior transcripts show today and yesterday only)；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)；TFA-94699 snapshot (TFA-92589 / PR #91 hands the purge of older lines to this ticket)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital patient whose admissionSummary.course holds four lines dated (server days) D-3 'RET-COURSE-912', D-2 'RET-COURSE-913', D-1 'RET-COURSE-914' and D0 'RET-COURSE-915'

When The purge runs (the server job; on main nothing touches admissionSummary.course); the raw document is read with admin access

Then Only the D-1 and D0 lines remain in the raw document; the D-3 and D-2 lines are gone, not only hidden from the timeline

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 ('Course timeline and prior transcripts therefore show today and yesterday only'), the TFA-92589 -> TFA-94699 purge handoff and the 3.7 retention claim: the D-3 line present in any form = Fail (older than 36 h under any reading); the D-2 line in the raw document = Fail per U16 even if not shown; the D-1 or D0 line missing = Fail (too early). Days are server days (3.8)

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92589 ready for qa；TFA-94699 in progress

病程上次更新 37 小时后，存储里还留着 3 天前和 2 天前的行——页面上藏起来了，但清理从来没删。

37 h after the course was last refreshed, the stored course still holds the lines from 3 and 2 days ago; the screen hides them, but the purge never deletes them.

依据：allure 3a385cb9-…-result.json; retention lane. 2 checks pass, 2 fail (D-3, D-2), known K6 (the TFA-92589 → TFA-94699 purge handoff). Which clock clears an old line (S26 vs TC-11/S25) is recorded only.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。
